def solve():
    coll = Q(15000) * (1 + Q(15) / 100)
    debt = Q(7000)
    liq = debt > Q("0.8") * coll
    if liq:
        repaid = debt * Q("0.45")
        seized = repaid * (1 + Q("0.10"))
    else:
        repaid = Q(0)
        seized = Q(0)
    remaining_coll = coll - seized
    remaining_debt = debt - repaid
    needed = remaining_debt / Q("0.7")
    deposit = max(needed - remaining_coll, Q(0))
    return {
        "final": deposit,
        "post_shock_collateral_value": coll,
        "repaid_debt": repaid,
        "seized_collateral_value": seized,
        "remaining_collateral_value": remaining_coll,
    }
